description: Exact outputs of the post-quantum producers for every registered suite except LESS (LESS signing is TypeScript only). ML-DSA (FIPS 204) and SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) sign in their DETERMINISTIC variant (ML-DSA rnd = 32 zero bytes; SLH-DSA opt_rand = PK.seed), with the pure (empty-context) interface; keygen is seeded (ML-DSA: the 32-byte xi; SLH-DSA: SK.seed || SK.prf || PK.seed); FN-DSA keygen and signing are seeded (SHAKE256 over the 32-byte seed / sign_seed). So `expect` is reproducible byte for byte. `ed_keys` are the Ed25519 identities (the same seeds as producer-vectors.json); `pq_keys` are named `<role>/<family>`. In `args`, `principal`/`holder`/`signer`/`to_holder`/`ed` name an Ed25519 key, and `pq`/`holder_pq` name a PQ key (null = none); `holder_pq` commits that key's `public`. `exact` lists the languages that must reproduce `expect` byte for byte (compare parsed JSON); every other language that verifies the suite must ACCEPT the expected artifact under the reference verifiers instead. sign_pcactn_suite signs a ready body (`args.body`, a PCActn without `sig`): bind `alg` and `pq_pk` into it, then sign "atlas-pca/actn/v2\u0000" || sha256(canonical(body)) (the header encoding is covered by producer-vectors.json). sign_artifact_suite `kind` is escalation_answer (signEscalationAnswer) or revocation_epoch (signRevocationEpoch; the guardian is `signer`).
